quarterly_data.quarter: SCREEN Holdings press release: Impact of the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake (Notice #3) (07-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: July 28, 2026 Kumamoto earthquake: as of July 31, some damage has been confirmed at SCREEN's facilities in the Kumamoto area; recovery efforts are under way and some operations have been impacted. Some damage has also been confirmed at certain clients and partner companies. The company said it is currently assessing the impact on business operations.
